description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` that provides batch processing with idle callbacks or setTimeout fallbacks. It is used to process large sets of items progressively in a React application, managing UI state during the operation.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller that applies batches of work items progressively, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback to yield control and maintain UI responsiveness.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to manage UI state (running, progress) and manage batch processing lifecycle inside React components.
